_readme: Maps HDA property names to the fields the CSAT service needs. Run `npm run hda:discover` to list the real property names for your HDA instance, then edit the right-hand values. Dotted paths (e.g. AssignedUserGroup.Description) read related objects, as supported by /WSC/Projection. Each ticket type can override closedStatusIds and any column, and add extra `filter` conditions.

sources._readme: Ticket sources (Incident.TicketSource). Synced with the owner groups; new ones arrive switched off. Inactive = no longer offered in HDA.

access._readme: Who is in which owner group (HDA Groups/Operators). Team admins may manage only these groups.

_fromHDAConnect: Confirmed from the HDAConnect repo (TicketService/HdaClientRepository): Incident uses Subject, ProblemHTML, ContactID, OwnerUserGroupID, TicketStatusID, TicketPriorityID, ServiceID; Contact has EMail; group IDs look like G815L; status S3C = new. HDAConnect filters with op "is" (Contact.EMail) and "equals" (Service.Name); if "eq" fails, try those in statusFilterOperator.
_fromQA: Verified against HDA QA on 2026-10-16. Incidents and Requests are both entity Incident, told apart by ObjectTypeID (Incident: T10C Incident, T10L Data Center, T8C HCM, T27L Retail LATAM, T19L RETAIL, T14L SSS; Request: 1 Service Request, T12L HR, T16L SSS, T29L Car Fleet). Left out on purpose: T21L Security Incident, T24L Quality issue, T25L IP Violation, T26L Master Data Mgmt, T30L Report Leaks. Status S18C = Solved (ClosureDate still empty), S5 = Closed (ClosureDate set), so surveys go out on S5. Changed 2026-10-21 (Reuben): surveys go out when a ticket is Solved – types watch S18C and S5 and use C70C, the custom "solved at" date (set on Solve, kept when HDA auto-closes ~5 days later; ResolutionDate/SolutionDate are not queryable). Ticket number is ID (no Code field). Contact.FirstName is empty; Contact.LastName holds the full name. No closure-code field found, so closeCode is null and the excluded-closure-codes rule has no effect. QA masks user emails (AssignedUser.EMail uses # instead of @). LoginEx needs an Accept-Language header (src/hda/client.js sends en-US).
